Contact

Found a bug, a wrong result, or want a tool that does not exist yet? Send it across — requests decide what gets built next.

Email

tools@bharatdn.com

What helps

  • Wrong result: the tool name, the exact inputs you used, the output you got and the output you expected.
  • Tool request: the task in one line, plus an example of the input and the output you want.
  • Bug: your browser and device, and what you tapped or typed just before it happened.

We read everything. We cannot promise a reply to every message, but every accurate bug report gets fixed.
